The offline EPIC collective collector is repaired and complete. Summary of the work:

## Architecture (in `/workspace/project`)

- **`solver.py`** â JSON stdin/stdout entry point. Validates the *entire* batch first (using the public format-only `request.py`); illegal requests return exactly `{"error":"invalid"}` with exit 0 and no compilation or partial results. Otherwise replays each case offline and prints one JSON object.
- **`collector.py`** â the collector state machine implementing the full `PROTOCOL.md` contract:
  - all six collectives with their exact output-space mappings (`q=p`, `q=3p+ord(d,s)`, `q=p mod (K/4)`, barrier `q=0`)
  - wire-validity â endpoint-validity classification (Ethernet/IPv4/UDP/BTH/AETH, header checksum, reflected CRC32 ICRC with the masked-byte rule), with malformed frames only advancing diagnostics
  - wrapped 24-bit PSNs, cumulative ACKs with the strict-increase / â¤-sent-prefix rule, mode 2 vs mode 3 safety ownership
  - bounded retention (`[b, min(K,b+N))`), logical slot identity, first-occurrence-wins duplicates, blocked/stale admission
  - retirement requiring completeness, all required outputs acknowledged and `U[r]>p` per required source
  - emission priority (upstream ACKs by rank â retry retransmissions â new results by rank/q), transport budget backpressure, repeat requests
  - certificates: 32-int state, FNV1a64 buffer digest, SHA256 wire transcript with rank/length prefixes, snapshots and trace
- **`builder.py` + `src/epic_fold.c`** â optional C accelerator (built in scratch) for the digest fold, with an identical pure-Python fallback so results never depend on the build.
- Supplied codec/switch sources, headers and `Makefile` retained and still building.

## Verification

- Both public examples pass byte-exactly.
- ~5,000 randomized cases cross-checked against an independently written literal reference implementation (0 mismatches), covering all primitives, both modes, reordering, duplicates, corruption, budgets, retries, snapshots and trains.
- Fast-path vs raw-wire slow-path equivalence, 46 wire-rule classification tests, 78 illegal-request tests, protocol invariant + determinism checks.
- Worst-case budgets: 1M ingress packets + 4M emissions in ~12 s, digest-heavy cases <1 s, 117 MiB peak RSS.
